description: List the UK medicines with a government severity tier currently in force — WATCH (a Medicine Supply Notification), CONCERN (a restricted-export designation) or CRITICAL (a Serious Shortage Protocol) — ranked highest first, each with the citing act and its date. Optionally filter to one tier. Every tier is a citation of a public act, reproducible without trusting Pharmasync.

tier.description: Restrict to a single tier. Omit for all tiers.
